BiblicalUsage: Berith means "covenant." It is the name of the god Berith, in whose house the men of Shechem took refuge. You will find it in Judges 9:46.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a god named covenant is the saddest kind of lie — men trusted a name that could not keep them. The house they hid in became their grave, and that is what a false covenant comes to.
